Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

row.answer: All Out displaces an enemy champion and follows them, carrying them through terrain when a valid wall is in the path. Crossing terrain adds damage. K'Sante then gains damage, healing and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
row.counterplay: Avoid standing between him and a wall; respect his increased damage and look for openings when his defensive charge is down.
